mapper.sql:
w."単語ID", w."旧単語ID", w."見出し語", w."読み", w."見出し語キー", w."読みキー", w."JLPTレベル", w."状態コード", w."備考", w."バージョン",
COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(w."品詞"), ''), d."品詞") AS "品詞", COALESCE(sense."中国語", d."説明_中国語") AS "中国語訳", col."書籍", col."分類", col."レベル", col."単語SEQ", COALESCE(col."収録数", 0) AS "収録数", COALESCE(s."学習状態", 'NOT_STARTED') AS "学習状態", COALESCE(s."総合習得度", 0) AS "総合習得度", COALESCE(s."回答回数", 0) AS "回答回数", COALESCE(s."正解回数", 0) AS "正解回数", COALESCE(s."お気に入りフラグ", false) AS "お気に入りフラグ", COALESCE(s."習得済フラグ", false) AS "習得済フラグ", s."最終学習日時", s."次回復習日時", ai."詳細AI状態", ai."読問題AI状態", ai."漢字読問題AI状態", ai."文脈問題AI状態", ai."漢字問題AI状態"

FROM public."JPN_単語情報" w LEFT JOIN public."JPN_学習状況情報" s ON s."単語ID" = w."単語ID" AND s."利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId} LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c."書籍", c."分類", c."レベル", c."単語SEQ", count(*) OVER () AS "収録数" FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" c WHERE c."単語ID" = w."単語ID" ORDER BY c."レベル", c."書籍", c."分類", c."単語SEQ" LIMIT 1 ) col ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT dv."詳細ID", dv."品詞", dv."説明_中国語" FROM public."JPN_単語詳細情報" dv WHERE dv."単語ID" = w."単語ID" AND dv."状態コード" = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY dv."詳細ID" DESC LIMIT 1 ) d ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sn."中国語" FROM public."JPN_単語詳細_語義情報" sn WHERE sn."詳細ID" = d."詳細ID" ORDER BY sn."表示順", sn."語義ID" LIMIT 1 ) sense ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (array_agg(CASE WHEN a."成功あり" THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE a."状態コード" END ORDER BY a."成功あり" DESC, a."登録日時" DESC NULLS LAST) FILTER (WHERE a."内容種別コード" = 'A_DETAIL'))[1] AS "詳細AI状態", (array_agg(CASE WHEN a."成功あり" THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE a."状態コード" END ORDER BY a."成功あり" DESC, a."登録日時" DESC NULLS LAST) FILTER (WHERE a."内容種別コード" = 'C1_READING'))[1] AS "読問題AI状態", (array_agg(CASE WHEN a."成功あり" THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE a."状態コード" END ORDER BY a."成功あり" DESC, a."登録日時" DESC NULLS LAST) FILTER (WHERE a."内容種別コード" = 'C2_KANJI'))[1] AS "漢字読問題AI状態", (array_agg(CASE WHEN a."成功あり" THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE a."状態コード" END ORDER BY a."成功あり" DESC, a."登録日時" DESC NULLS LAST) FILTER (WHERE a."内容種別コード" = 'D_CONTEXT_MEANING'))[1] AS "文脈問題AI状態", (array_agg(CASE WHEN a."成功あり" THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE a."状態コード" END ORDER BY a."成功あり" DESC, a."登録日時" DESC NULLS LAST) FILTER (WHERE a."内容種別コード" = 'E_KANJI_USAGE'))[1] AS "漢字問題AI状態" FROM public."v_jpn_word_ai_state" a WHERE a."単語ID" = w."単語ID" ) ai ON TRUE

sql.if: AND (w."見出し語" ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR w."見出し語キー" ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND (w."読み" ILIKE '%' || #{reading} || '%' OR w."読みキー" ILIKE '%' || #{reading} || '%')
AND COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(w."品詞"), ''), d."品詞") ILIKE '%' || #{part} || '%'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" cb WHERE cb."単語ID" = w."単語ID" AND cb."書籍" ILIKE '%' || #{book} || '%')

if.test: (categoryFrom != null and categoryFrom != '') or (categoryTo != null and categoryTo != '')

mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY col."書籍" ASC NULLS LAST, col."分類" ASC NULLS LAST, COALESCE(col."単語SEQ", 0) ASC, w."単語ID" ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

choose.when: (CASE WHEN ai."読問題AI状態" = 'SUCCEEDED' OR ai."漢字読問題AI状態" = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 'SUCCEEDED' WHEN ai."読問題AI状態" IS NOT NULL THEN ai."読問題AI状態" ELSE ai."漢字読問題AI状態" END)

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS "total", count(*) FILTER (WHERE () = 'SUCCEEDED') AS "acquired", count(*) FILTER (WHERE () IS DISTINCT FROM 'SUCCEEDED' AND () IS DISTINCT FROM 'RUNNING' AND () IS DISTINCT FROM 'QUEUED') AS "candidates"

SELECT count(*) AS "wordCount", count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(s."習得済フラグ", false)) AS "learnedCount", count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(s."お気に入りフラグ", false)) AS "favoriteCount", COALESCE(round(avg(s."総合習得度") FILTER (WHERE s."総合習得度" IS NOT NULL), 2), 0) AS "averageMastery", COALESCE(sum(s."回答回数"), 0) AS "answeredCount" FROM public."JPN_単語情報" w LEFT JOIN public."JPN_学習状況情報" s ON s."単語ID" = w."単語ID" AND s."利用者アカウントID" = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."JPN_単語情報" ( "見出し語", "読み", "見出し語キー", "読みキー", "JLPTレベル", "品詞", "状態コード", "備考", "登録者アカウントID", "登録元コード" ) VALUES ( #{word}, #{reading,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{wordKey}, #{readingKey}, #{jlptLevel,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{partOfSpeech}, #{stateCode}, #{note}, #{createdBy}, 'APP' )
mapper.update: UPDATE public."JPN_単語情報" SET "見出し語" = #{word}, "読み" = #{reading,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, "見出し語キー" = #{wordKey}, "読みキー" = #{readingKey}, "JLPTレベル" = #{jlptLevel,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, "品詞" = #{partOfSpeech}, "状態コード" = #{stateCode}, "備考" = #{note}, "更新者アカウントID" = #{updatedBy}, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "バージョン" = "バージョン" + 1, "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "単語ID" = #{wordId} AND "バージョン" = #{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public."JPN_単語情報" WHERE "単語ID" = #{wordId}
mapper.select: SELECT "収録ID" AS "collectionId", "単語ID" AS "wordId", "レベル" AS "level", "書籍" AS "book", "分類" AS "category", "単語SEQ" AS "wordSeq", "掲載見出し語" AS "listedWord", "掲載読み" AS "listedReading", "掲載品詞" AS "listedPartOfSpeech", "掲載中国語意味" AS "chineseMeaning" FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" WHERE "単語ID" = #{wordId} ORDER BY "レベル", "書籍", "分類", "単語SEQ"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."JPN_単語収録情報" ( "単語ID", "レベル", "書籍", "書籍ID", "分類", "単語SEQ", "掲載見出し語", "掲載品詞", "掲載中国語意味", "出典JSON", "状態コード", "登録者アカウントID", "登録元コード" ) VALUES ( #{wordId}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{level}, ''), 'N1-N5'), #{book}, (SELECT b."書籍ID" FROM public."JPN_書籍情報" b WHERE b."書籍名" = #{book} LIMIT 1), #{category}, #{wordSeq}, #{listedWord}, #{listedPartOfSpeech}, #{listedChineseMeaning}, '{}'::jsonb, 'ACTIVE', #{accountId}, 'APP' )
mapper.select: SELECT b."書籍ID" FROM public."JPN_書籍情報" b WHERE b."書籍名" = #{book} ORDER BY b."書籍ID" LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(b."書籍コード"::int) FROM public."JPN_書籍情報" b WHERE b."書籍コード" ~ '^[0-9]+$'
mapper.update: UPDATE public."JPN_書籍情報" AS b SET "分類数" = c."分類数", "収録語数" = c."収録語数", "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT col."分類") AS "分類数", COUNT(*) AS "収録語数" FROM public."JPN_単語収録情報" col WHERE col."書籍" = #{book} AND col."状態コード" = 'ACTIVE' ) AS c WHERE b."書籍名" = #{book}
mapper.select: SELECT q."問題ID" AS "questionId", q."単語ID" AS "wordId", q."問題種別" AS "questionType", q."問題番号" AS "questionNo", q."問題文_日本語" AS "questionTextJa", q."正解値" AS "correctValue", (SELECT count(*) FROM public."JPN_単語問題選択肢情報" c WHERE c."問題ID" = q."問題ID") AS "choiceCount" FROM public."JPN_単語問題情報" q WHERE q."単語ID" = #{wordId} ORDER BY q."問題種別", q."問題番号", q."問題ID"

SELECT g."内容種別コード" AS "questionType", g."内容版数" AS "contentVersion", g."状態コード" AS "generationState", g."AI区分" AS "aiProvider", g."モデル名" AS "aiModel", g."生成件数" AS "generatedCount", g."失敗件数" AS "failedCount", g."エラーメッセージ" AS "errorMessage", g."開始日時" AS "startedAt", g."終了日時" AS "finishedAt", g."生成ID" AS "generationId", (SELECT count(*) FROM public."JPN_単語問題情報" q WHERE q."単語ID" = g."単語ID" AND q."問題種別" = g."内容種別コード" AND q."内容版数" = g."内容版数") AS "questionCount", (SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(q."状態コード" = 'ACTIVE'), false) FROM public."JPN_単語問題情報" q WHERE q."単語ID" = g."単語ID" AND q."問題種別" = g."内容種別コード" AND q."内容版数" = g."内容版数") AS "active" FROM public."JPN_AI生成履歴情報" g WHERE g."単語ID" = #{wordId} AND g."内容種別コード" IN ('C1_READING', 'C2_KANJI', 'D_CONTEXT_MEANING', 'E_KANJI_USAGE') ORDER BY g."内容種別コード", g."内容版数" DESC, g."生成ID" DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE public."JPN_単語問題情報" SET "状態コード" = CASE WHEN "内容版数" = #{contentVersion} THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'ARCHIVED' END, "更新者アカウントID" = #{accountId}, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "単語ID" = #{wordId} AND "問題種別" = #{questionType}
mapper.select: SELECT other."読み" FROM public."JPN_単語情報" w JOIN public."JPN_単語情報" other ON other."見出し語キー" = w."見出し語キー" AND other."単語ID" <> w."単語ID" AND other."状態コード" = 'ACTIVE' AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(other."読み", '')), '') IS NOT NULL WHERE w."単語ID" = #{wordId} ORDER BY other."単語ID" LIMIT 1
